title: SDD Per-Cycle Tasks (sdd/specs/{spec-id}/cycles/cycle-XX/tasks.json)
description: Canonical task registry of one cycle. Created by sdd-planner, task statuses updated by sdd-implementor-*, closed by sdd-reviewer. The root sdd/tasks.json is only an index over these files.

flow.description: full = complete SDD cycle (functional/planner/architect). reduced = structural refactor without user stories. lite = single-actor cycle driven by plan.md. Tasks may have empty user_stories only in reduced and lite.

usageSource.description: Where the number came from. session-report: the harness session usage report (Claude Code main loop). stats-command: /stats (Gemini CLI). api-usage: usage returned by the model API. agent-usage-notification: the exact per-subagent count the harness reports to the parent when a subagent finishes (Claude Code Agent tool: <usage><subagent_tokens>N</subagent_tokens>…</usage>) — exact, approx: false. declared-estimate: the agent declared an order-of-magnitude estimate because the harness exposes no counter (Copilot, Antigravity, Gemini CLI subagents) — MUST pair with approx: true.

id.description: Convention for new cycles: TASK-[NNN] (e.g. TASK-001). Scope is this file, so no cycle/spec prefix is needed. Legacy formats are tolerated by the pattern.

user_stories.description: HU/US ids from functional.md. Empty array only for flow: reduced.

usage.description: Telemetry for this task, recorded by the agent that executed it WHEN IT CLOSES the task (never reconstructed later). Since v0.11.0 provider_model, tokens_in, tokens_out, approx and source are mandatory in the protocol — the orchestrator does not mark a task done without them and the validator errors on cycles completed from 2026-09-02 that lack them (older records keep validating with the legacy model_tier). With no counter available (Copilot, Antigravity) record a declared estimate with approx: true — never omit. Feeds the viewer's Costs dashboard.

provider_model.description: Provider-namespaced model actually used (claude/sonnet, gemini/flash, copilot/gpt-5-mini). Mandatory since v0.11.0 (the validator errors on units closed from that date without it); model_tier is the pre-0.11 name and is still read as an alias.

model_tier.description: Legacy alias of provider_model (kits before v0.11.0). Prefer provider_model. Bare legacy values (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable) are read as claude/*.

effort.description: Effort / thinking level declared BEFORE executing (Claude: low|medium|high|xhigh|max; Gemini: minimal|low|medium|high; none when the harness exposes no control).

agent.description: SDD role that executed this task.

tokens_total.description: Exact total when the source reports a single number (agent-usage-notification). tokens_in/tokens_out then carry the documented default split (85/15) so the cost formula still works; the viewer shows tokens_total.

approx.description: true when the numbers are a declared estimate rather than a counter reading. Mandatory (explicit) since v0.11.0; absent is read as false (measured) for older records.

recorded_at.description: When the unit closed (date or ISO datetime).
